units.source_text: 他站在门口，抬头望望天空。

en.t: He stood in the doorway and looked up at the sky.

units.source_text: 总算看到了朝阳那红彤彤的面庞，轻柔的棉毛细云……

en.t: At last he could see the ruddy face of the morning sun and the soft, fine clouds like cotton down...

units.source_text: 终于没有等来企盼的下雨天。

en.t: In the end, the longed-for rainy day never came.

units.source_text: 每次呼出气，身体里的水都像在一点点消失似的。

en.t: Each time he breathed out, it felt as if the water inside his body were disappearing little by little.
